payload.criterion: ~/orchestra contains the seven skill directories and dashboard/, and both plugin manifests are named orchestra
payload.verify_command: cd ~/orchestra && test -d skills/engage && test -d skills/discuss && test -d skills/plan-phase && test -d skills/execute-phase && test -d skills/verify-work && test -d skills/init && test -d skills/analyze-sessions && test -d dashboard && python3 -c "import json; from pathlib import Path; names=[json.loads(Path(p).read_text())[\"name\"] for p in [\".cursor-plugin/plugin.json\",\".claude-plugin/plugin.json\"]]; assert names==[\"orchestra\",\"orchestra\"]"
